Join us for night skiing at Gunstock Mountain Resort! This trip is open to all experience levels. Trip leaders will assist with the rental process and help you navigate the ski resort. The trip fee includes transportation, a night lift ticket, ski rentals, and a helmet (participants are welcome to bring their own gear). We’ll begin skiing together as a group, then break off as appropriate, with regular check-ins from trip leaders throughout the evening. Meeting location: Hamel Recreation Center, Room 107 at 2:30 p.m. Return time: Approximately 10:00 p.m.
